In anticipation of new guests, Titanium Court is pleased to announce a number of new renovations and repairs. A summary of the changes can be found below.
Revised the save and checkpointing system so corrupted saves should now be rarer and more checkpoints exist to restore from in the event of save corruption.
A number of additional names have been added to the credits following new contributions.
Added an additional confirmation to a pivotal narrative decision.
Implemented a number of performance improvements to accommodate more venerable computing devices.
Added a slight delay before the game switches from gamepad mode to mouse mode to accommodate finicky mice that produce the occasional spurious input.
Added a few small variations to the text to account for witnessing certain scenes in an unexpected order.
Corrected a number of typos.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty's attention could wander to inaccessible elements of the user interface during a musical performance.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty claims to have seen a room before, despite having never seen the room before. Did she forget?
Corrected an issue where reviewing a specific memory in the journal would cause the game to cease operation.
Corrected an issue where a certain character might make another appearance despite having reached a definitive conclusion in a previous scene.
Corrected an issue where a certain rebellious ui panel refused to submit to the authority of the audio volume settings.
Corrected an issue where the game exhibited considerable decadence and refused to launch at anything other than the maximum possible resolution when launched in fullscreen mode.
Corrected a number of issues introduced by the aforementioned performance improvements.
Corrected an issue where the Dragon makes a surprise appearance despite previously exiting the narrative.
Corrected a rare issue where a particular scene could fail to progress depending on the layout of the battlefield.
Corrected an issue where duplicates could appear in the storage unit following the use of a mulligan.
Corrected an issue where the Court's representation on the world map failed to display the correct tooltip or health when inspected.
Corrected an issue where Steam Cloud save would occasionally restore a portion of an old file after it was intentionally deleted.
Corrected an issue where following the game's conclusion, the menu would continue to show now irrelevant information from the most recent war.
Corrected a small issue where the portable wall card displayed the wrong image following a scene reload.
Corrected an issue where those poor souls trapped by cobwebs would occasionally remain immobile even following the destruction of the web.
Corrected an issue where, in a select few circumstances, Her Majesty would suddenly teleport to her next destination rather than adhering to the Royal tradition of bipedal movement.
Corrected an issue where the narrative log declined to render certain icons, citing a clause in their contract concerning icon maximums.
Corrected an issue where soldier units, in a concerning breach of trust, would continue to attack friendly tentacles.
Corrected a number of issues related to making offerings to the Leviathan.
Corrected an issue where soldiers could occasionally exhibit supernatural agility after besting a foe.
Corrected an issue where the gamepad cursor failed to stand on the correct side of another overlay, thus appearing diminished to the average observer.
Corrected an issue where text would occasionally appear jumbled, particularly prevalent when using the higher resolution font options.
Corrected an issue where using the double beam on the jar and another fierce foe simultaneously would create confusion surrounding the proper order of events.
Corrected an issue where declining to confirm the use of the Skip Battle card would fail to refund the cost of the card.
Removed a single (somewhat useless and uninteresting) card that was never intended for public consumption yet somehow managed to negotiate its way into the game under rare circumstances.
Corrected an issue where tentacles could land a deadly blow even after the conclusion of a battle.
Corrected an issue where opening the pause menu at specific moments confused the gamepad cursor such that it lost its way.
Corrected an issue where vanity mirrors neglected to apply all of the Court's passive effects when gathering resources.
Corrected an issue where the "bed rest" card uncharacteristically insisted upon making noise at the start of battle for some reason.
Corrected an issue where certain puppets failed to maintain their stance as high tide rolled in during certain scenes.
Corrected an issue where The Admiral's flagship continued to loiter on the world map despite no longer being part of the current war.
Corrected an issue where a set of song lyrics failed to make their way into the game's text log.
Corrected an issue where certain options failed to appear during battlefield selection under rare circumstances.
Corrected an issue where choosing the resource penalty twice (after losing two eggs/footballs in the same battle) could cause more than two resources to be taken during the second penalty.
Corrected an issue where thorns could land a deadly counterattack even after the conclusion of a battle.
Corrected an issue where, following certain victory conditions, the Court would neglect to tidy up it's undo stack before retiring to bed.
Corrected a number of minor visual glitches.
Corrected an issue where the weather report failed to update while representing the current state of the final battle.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty believed the Pareidolic Pumpkin to be unlit despite it clearly glowing.
Corrected an issue where the cobweb insurance refused to process claims for cobwebs that had yet to trigger.
Corrected an issue where the passive effects panel would highlight an effect a considerable amount of time after the effect activated.
Corrected an issue where A performer neglected to highlight his portrait while speaking. Poor form.
Corrected an issue where the card panel failed to close after reviewing a tutorial in the journal.
Corrected an issue where friendly tentacles would throw projectiles despite not having a target.
Corrected an issue where Puck would write Her Majesty a letter despite having previously exited the narrative.
Corrected a number of issues where it was possible to navigate hidden ui elements with the gamepad cursor.
Corrected an issue where a mulligan would allow Her Majesty to retry from Low Tide even when the Court suffered defeat during High Tide.
Corrected an issue where a couple cards were missing appropriate icons.
Corrected an issue where the Leviathan would appear to be friendly on the weather report despite that being not the case.
Corrected an issue where grids would occasionally move out of the way to avoid contact with Leland.
Corrected an issue where the M.A.R.K.E.T. transaction limit would fail to reset after a battle under certain conditions.
Corrected an issue where I neglected to highlight my own portrait properly during a musical performance. How embarrassing!
Corrected an issue where the UI neglected to move out of the way of a certain portrait
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty’s Enemy would reappear despite previously departing from the narrative.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45930397/cb4fc3672003cbd830f1065057198a6fb3502b28.png"]
Titanium Court is pleased to announce a number of renovations following its grand opening last week. A summary of these changes can be found below.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty reacts to the alleged reappearance of the "toll road" despite having yet to encounter any tolls.
A rare intrusive thought involving the pumpkin and the storage unit has been suppressed.
Robin's calculator was known to malfunction in the presence of extreme heat. This flaw in its engineering has now been addressed in a recent software update.

A later scene where Her Majesty attempts to leave after previously losing a duel with her enemy has been updated to take into account that, excuse me, Her Majesty may have had MULTIPLE duels and she may have even WON some of them, thankyouverymuch.
Corrected an issue where a certain someone occasionally failed to highlight their portrait sprite properly while speaking, how embarrassing for them.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty makes plans involving her steward despite fully understanding that her steward no longer possesses the capacity to be any part of such plans. Did she forget?
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty claims to remember something that almost certainly never happened.
Corrected an issue where the Bloodsucker job continued to heal the Court even after the Court's defeat, adding a kind of insult to injury.
Corrected an issue where the Dragon job declined to flash when it was actively earning money.
Corrected an issue where the journal occasionally forgot which save slot the player was using and decided to arbitrarily and occasionally erroneously return them to slot 1. Rude!
Corrected an issue where a single arrow could still fell the Court despite the battle having paused due to an exciting discovery.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty's tooltip believed "temendous" to be the correct spelling for "tremendous".
Corrected an issue where Puck knows Her Majesty's name despite never learning it.
Corrected an issue where if Her Majesty performs a rare and dramatic "double"-betrayal of her poor steward, she is only forced to endure the consequences of a single betrayal.
Corrected an issue where it was possible to receive a duplicate of certain cards from chests, allowing for a number of additional issues when those duplicates were sold.

Corrected an issue where a musical performance would abruptly end when a new audio device was plugged in. Now the game will pause after such an occurrence to allow the new audio device to get appropriately situated.
Corrected an issue where the option to go to bed at night was not available despite there being no other methods of proceeding to the next day except the "Restart" option in the pause menu.
Corrected an issue where The Leviathan overreacted to the use of fire vs. its tentacles.

Corrected an issue where Vanity mirrors would copy the damage inflicted by the reverse philosopher's stone without also copying the wealth obtained by such a bargain. Now the wealth should also be appropriately copied, producing a potent and dangerous combo.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty and her heir were capable of sharing a birthday, causing much confusion among members of the Court.
Corrected an issue of the UTMOST importance where a line consisting of "* ...." was mistakingly printed as "* ..."
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty behaved as if she never encountered Puck's dressing room despite previously doing so.
Corrected an issue where the Leviathan did not properly respect the sanctity of the undo button as far as offerings are concerned.
Corrected an issue where the wrong Admiral fires upon the Court.

Corrected an issue where a wager preventing the Court from gaining resources during High Tide also prevented the Court from LOSING resources during High Tide, allowing for an otherwise impossible "free lunch" to make an appearance.
Corrected an issue where Her Majesty was prevented from leaving through no fault of her own and no plot of her enemy.
Corrected an issue where the Curse of War could not be completed under rare circumstances concerning a broken shower.

The "barb" card claimed to take absorb damage meant for your Court, yet refused to report its shields through the standardized bureaucratic process used by every other card. As such, it has lost its license to absorb damage and its resource cost has been adjusted to reflect this change.

Management has taken note of the fact that the storage unit would frequently play hooky despite serving an essential role in certain late-game proceedings . The unit has received a thorough talking to and promises to make additional appearances as necessary.
The schemes of Her Majesty's enemy have been slightly expedited in certain situations to keep pace with precocious players.

Copies of the Dragon and Diregoats made by the Mirror now no longer pass the damage they receive along to their Court, meaning fewer surprising defeats will occur as a result of this strategy. To maintain consistency, the Dragon card has also been adjusted to no longer pass its damage along to the Court and the Dragon's resource cost has been increased to compensate for the removal of this weakness.
Use of the "Restart" feature in the pause menu has been restricted to prevent it from being used in situations that might cause inconsistencies in Her Majesty's recollection of events.

An additional option to disable "Fast Animations" has been added to the accessibility section of the options menu. The animations enabled/disabled by this toggle are the UI animations on the main menu and the page turn animation that occurs as dialogue proceeds.
